Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.compass

Interface CompassTrackerService

public interface CompassTrackerService
Teammate tracker item, target selection, and live action-bar control.

Since 1.8.0 the tracker can also be customized: registerTargetFilter(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.compass.CompassTargetFilter) narrows who a compass may point at, CompassTargetChangeEvent reports every target change, and CompassTrackerDisplayEvent rewrites or hides the tracker's action bar. Teammate-only tracking stays the rule either way.

Since:
1.6.0

    • registerTargetFilter

      @NotNull default @NotNull Registration registerTargetFilter(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, @NotNull @NotNull CompassTargetFilter filter)
      Adds a filter every tracker target must pass, on top of Zentrix's own teammate rules.

      Filters only narrow the eligible teammates, in getEligibleTargets(org.bukkit.entity.Player), cycleTarget(org.bukkit.entity.Player), setTarget(org.bukkit.entity.Player, org.bukkit.entity.Player) and the automatic nearest-teammate choice alike; a remembered target a filter starts refusing is dropped at the next update. A teammate is eligible only when every registered filter allows it.

      Parameters:
      owner - the registering plugin; the filter is removed when it is disabled
      filter - the filter
      Returns:
      the registration, to remove the filter early
      Since:
      1.8.0
